notablePrerequisites: Four additional spirits on the battlefield.
description:
Pay {1}{W} to cast False Dawn, drawing a card.
Kykar triggers, creating a spirit.
On ETB, the spirit triggers Mana Echoes, generating {5}.
Sacrifice the spirit to Kykar to generate {W}.
Since you may spend white mana as though it were mana of any color, pay {5}{U} to cast Wispers of the Muse with buyback, drawing a card.
Repeat from step 2.
